title: Binary block encoding
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $b$, there is a bijection between Boolean strings of length $nb$ and length-$n$ sequences whose entries are integers from $0$ through $2^b-1$, obtained by grouping the bits into $n$ consecutive blocks of length $b$ and interpreting each block as a binary integer.
